_readme: Source of truth for every destination and category photo. Each entry was found by searching for the exact place, viewed and matched to the real place before being accepted ('verified' = what the photo actually shows; 'alt' = the alt text shown to screen readers). scripts/build-photo-links.py resolves the entries into direct links (photos.json): Wikimedia Commons entries ('title' = the File: page; CC BY / CC BY-SA / CC0 / public domain, credit = author + licence) link to the 1280 px rendition on upload.wikimedia.org; Unsplash entries ('id' = CDN photo id; Unsplash License) link to images.unsplash.com; 'owner' entries are photos GoWin staff uploaded through the admin panel, stored as WebP next to this file and uploaded to the public 'media' bucket by scripts/migrate-content.mjs.
